name: Lakme Eyeconic Kajal

name: L'Oreal Paris Infallible More Than Concealer
why: Formulated for up to 24-hour wear without a fragrance additive flag on the ingredient list — a reasonable pick for concealer-sensitive skin.

name: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Serum Foundation
why: A rare foundation with an actual active ingredient concentration disclosed on the label, matching the brand's ingredient-transparency approach elsewhere in skincare.
